title: Rust NonVolatile trait alignment
description: Ensure Rust NonVolatile trait (read, write, delete) provides atomic durable writes matching Zephyr storage semantics. Validate FileStorage and InMemoryStorage implementations.
close_reason: Already implemented correctly: NonVolatile trait documents atomicity guarantees, FileStorage uses atomic write-sync-rename-sync pattern, MemStorage provides test support, and 22 tests validate behavior including crash safety and durability
